tools.name: preflight_csv
tools.description: Checks a contact or lead CSV (passed as text, up to 500 data rows and 64 KiB) before a CRM import and reports what it finds: duplicate emails (matched ignoring case and surrounding spaces), invalid email syntax, role or shared inboxes (info@, sales@ and similar), blank required fields (placeholders

tools.name: preflight_sample
tools.description: Runs the same checks as preflight_csv on the checker's built-in sample CSV (fake placeholder data) and returns the sample plus its report, so you can see the report format without sending a file. Detection only; does not store or log your CSV.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: preflight_csv · Private data: preflight_csv, preflight_sample · Public sink: preflight_csv · Destructive: preflight_sample.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: preflight_csv · Private data: preflight_csv, preflight_sample · Public sink: preflight_csv · Destructive: preflight_sample

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
